The migration adds a unique index on `topic_embeds.embed_url` (db/migrate/20131217174004_create_topic_embeds.rb), so concurrent callers can both observe `embed.blank?` and then race to insert; the second will raise a uniqueness error (e.g., `ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique`) and there is no rescue/fallback to re-load the now-existing row. This is a real concurrency correctness issue grounded in the diff.
